easyPrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
Inspired Skypainter is prepared.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Great Whale.
Codie triggers, copying Maestro's Gift, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Resolve the copy of Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste
When the Inspired Skypainter token enters, it triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Resolve the original Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Great Whale with haste
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
